name: Exact Confinement Versus Asymptotic Budgets

core_distinction.finite_completion: some finite stage proves zero defect
core_distinction.infinite_fixed_ledger_squeeze: same positive zero-displacement object is dominated by budgets tending to zero
core_distinction.insufficient: moving finite-stage defects decrease but never squeeze a fixed/exhaustive object

moving_ledger_requirement.condition: A_Z <= A_Z,n + T_n, A_Z,n <= B_n, tr(B_n+T_n)->0

nonclaims: decreasing finite-stage defect alone is not exact confinement
squeezing a moving/truncated ledger is not full zero confinement without tail/exhaustivity
asymptotic numeric improvement is not a proof unless it yields fixed/exhaustive domination
